notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40846980/d1c0766fda337d378b379975c25d5f3603dba154.png[/img]

Things are heating up with a planned release of New Years.

Run of the meal update:
- Million little bug fixes
- Added screen adjustments
- Lowered sound effects a bit
- Corrected issue un Add-On mode where music changed too often. 
- Added the capability for levels 160+ (locked to 80 in demo)
- Added new enemy skins for higher levels.

Thanks for all the support. I'll be taking aim at my Pacify game mode next.

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40846980/01c55050672ca627072b0e58bc5a530370ec5d4c.png[/img]

Thanks to the community for all the feedback, improvements have been made to the user interface. 

Due to some some some overachievers, I hurried up and added leaderboards and expanded the max level allowed in the demo. The current plan is to keep the leaderboards from the demo and continue them into the commercial release.

I have many more improvements and fixes, as well as other game modes to add so I'll keep it brief. Thanks for all the support!
